question: The area of the rhombus (in cm²) having each side equal to 13 cm and one of its diagonals equal to 24 cm is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side (a) = 13 cm and half-diagonal (d₁/2) = 12 cm.

The half-diagonals and the side form a right-angled triangle (5, 12, 13 triplet).

∴ Half of the second diagonal (d₂/2) = 5 cm → d₂ = 10 cm.

Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂ = (1/2) × 24 × 10 = 120 cm².

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Side (a) = 13 cm, Diagonal (d₁) = 24 cm.

Formula: Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂ and a² = (d₁/2)² + (d₂/2)²
